dosing.evidence: DOI (6 mg/kg) or saline was delivered via IP injection 30 minutes before the start of behavior. For dose response experiments at 2 mg/kg, DOI was dissolved in saline.

handling.evidence: Mice were left undisturbed for 1-week following arrival before the start of testing; no explicit handling protocol described.

day_night_flipped.evidence: maintained on a 12h reverse light-dark cycle (lights on at 9PM)

assays.assay_description: Novel arena (41x28x15 cm) with 5 cm corn cob bedding and 20 marbles. Mice explored for 30 min; marbles counted at 10, 20, 30 min. Tested at 30 min, 6 h, and 24 h post-DOI, and on Day 2 with optogenetic reactivation of scFLARE2-tagged neurons.

application_type.evidence: DOI (6 mg/kg) or saline was delivered via IP injection 30 minutes before the start of behavior.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were placed in the corner of a novel arena

setup_restrain.evidence: Mice were allowed to explore the arena for 30 minutes

food_restriction.evidence: No food was present in the testing arena during the 30-min session.

water_restriction.evidence: No water source was present in the testing arena.

time_to_assay.evidence: Mice were run on the marble burying test 30 minutes following injection... 6 hours following injection... 24 hours post-injection

sample_size.evidence: n = 20 mice per group (30 min); n = 12 mice per group (6 h); n = 5 mice per group (dose response)

outcomes.summary: Acute DOI (6 mg/kg) reduced marble burying at 30 min and 6 h post-injection (anxiolytic). At 24 h, DOI-treated mice buried more marbles than saline controls (rebound anxiogenic), an effect more apparent in males. Optogenetic reactivation of DOI-tagged mPFC neurons on Day 2 recapitulated the reduced burying.
outcomes.statistics: Unpaired Student's t test; *P<0.05, **P<0.01, ***P<0.001, ****P<0.0001. Two-way ANOVA with Tukey's multiple comparisons for Day 1/Day 2 reactivation analyses.
outcomes.evidence: mice still exhibited a reduction in marble burying... mice injected with DOI were examined again 24 hours later, they unexpectedly buried more marbles... This rebound anxiety-like effect was more apparent in males than in females

B1_num_measures.evidence: marbles buried, head twitch count, velocity/locomotion

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The number of buried marbles were counted 10-, 20-, and 30-minutes following the start of the test

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences reported.

B5_social.evidence: Mice were placed in the corner of a novel arena (tested alone).

B6_cognitive.evidence: Innate anxiety/compulsivity test, no learning required.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Locomotion was scored post-hoc using behavioral tracking software (Ethovision XT 15, Noldus); HTR scored manually.

B8_multivariate.evidence: LDA performed on single variables; no multivariate dimensionality reduction across features.

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed refuge in the arena.

E3_bedding.evidence: filled with 5 cm of 1/8 inch corn cob bedding

E5_enrichment.evidence: Only marbles (test stimuli) present; not enrichment objects.

E6_spatial.evidence: Arena is a single open compartment.

E7_social_context.evidence: Focal mouse was the only animal in the arena.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the testing apparatus during the 30-min test.

D1_continuity.evidence: Tested at 30 min, 6 h, 24 h post-injection, and again on Day 2 with reactivation.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Mice were allowed to explore the arena for 30 minutes

D3_recording_days.evidence: 30 min, 6 h, 24 h post-injection sessions plus Day 2 reactivation.

D5_followup.evidence: 24 hours post-injection, they were reintroduced to the marble burying test

D6_circadian.evidence: Each session was 30 min; none exceeded 6 h.

assays.assay_description: Number of head twitches (rapid side-to-side rotational head movements) scored manually by a blinded experimenter during the first 10 minutes of the MBT session. Measured at 30 min, 6 h post-DOI and on Day 2 during optogenetic reactivation.

application_type.evidence: DOI (6 mg/kg) or saline was delivered via IP injection 30 minutes before the start of behavior.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were placed in the corner of a novel arena

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the testing arena.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the testing arena.

time_to_assay.evidence: 30 minutes following injection... 6 hours following injection... 24 hours later (Day 2 reactivation)

sample_size.evidence: n = 8 mice per group (Fig 1F); n = 10-11 mice per group (Fig 1J); n = 9-10 mice per group (Fig 5K)

outcomes.summary: DOI significantly elevated HTRs at 30 min post-injection but not at 6 h. Optogenetic reactivation of DOI-tagged mPFC neurons on Day 2 did NOT elicit elevated HTRs, dissociating the anxiolytic and hallucinogenic-like effects.
outcomes.statistics: Unpaired Student's t test (Fig 1F, 1J); two-way ANOVA with Tukey's multiple-comparisons test (Fig 5K). ****P<0.0001; ns reported for 6 h and Day 2.
outcomes.evidence: mice also showed an elevated HTR 30 min after DOI injection... no longer exhibited elevated HTRs [at 6 h]... did not increase HTRs during orange light stimulation of DOI-activated neurons on day 2

B1_num_measures.evidence: Number of HTRs during the first 10 min of the MBT

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total count over the first 10 min only.

B4_ethological.evidence: HTR is treated as a drug-evoked response, not a natural ethological behaviour (per rubric).

B7_automated_classification.evidence: HTRs scored by experimenter blind to conditions.

E3_bedding.evidence: 5 cm corn cob bedding in arena.

D1_continuity.evidence: HTR scored at 30 min, 6 h, and again on Day 2.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Number of HTRs during the first 10 min of the MBT

D3_recording_days.evidence: Multiple recording days (30 min/6 h and Day 2 reactivation).

D5_followup.evidence: Day 2 (24 h) HTR scoring during reactivation.

assays.assay_description: Cross-shaped maze with 2 open and 2 closed arms (30x5 cm). Mice placed in centre and allowed to explore for 10 min. Primary measures: % time in open arms, closed arms, centre, and velocity (Ethovision tracking). Tested at 30 min, 6 h, 24 h post-DOI and during Day 2 optogenetic reactivation.

application_type.evidence: DOI (6 mg/kg) or saline was delivered via IP injection 30 minutes before the start of behavior.

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were placed in the center of a cross shaped maze (no prior habituation described).

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the EPM during testing.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the EPM during testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: EPM performed 30 min, 6 hours, and 24 hours following injection with DOI or saline; also performed on Day 2 during optogenetic reactivation.

sample_size.evidence: n = 8 to 10 mice per group (30 min); n = 7 to 9 mice per group (6 h); n = 10 to 11 mice per group (Fig 5F)

outcomes.summary: DOI increased time spent in open arms at 30 min and 6 h post-injection (anxiolytic). At 24 h, a trend towards more time in closed arms was observed (rebound anxiogenic). Optogenetic reactivation of DOI-tagged neurons on Day 2 increased time spent in the open arms, recapitulating the anxiolytic effect.
outcomes.statistics: Two-tailed Student's t-test; unpaired Student's t test (Fig 5F). *P<0.05, **P<0.01.
outcomes.evidence: DOI-treated mice spending more time in the open arms compared with saline-treated mice... EPM showed a trend for this anxiogenic effect at 24 hours, with more time spent in the closed arms... orange light stimulation of DOI-tagged neurons increased the amount of time that mice spent in the open arms of the EPM

B1_num_measures.evidence: % time in open arms, % time in closed arms, % time in centre, velocity

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total time over the 10-min session reported.

E1_environment_type.evidence: cross shaped maze with 2 open arms and 2 closed arms

E2_shelter.evidence: EPM closed arms are part of apparatus design, not a shelter (per rubric).

E6_spatial.evidence: EPM arms are extensions of a central platform, not separate compartments (per rubric).

D1_continuity.evidence: EPM tested at 30 min, 6 h, 24 h, and on Day 2.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Multiple recording days (30 min/6 h/24 h cohorts and Day 2 reactivation).

D5_followup.evidence: EPM at 24 h and Day 2 reactivation (≥24 h after last drug).

judge_notes: Three behavioural assays retained: Marble Burying Test, Head Twitch Response (scored during MBT session window but a distinct behavioural domain/measure), and Elevated Plus Maze. Two candidates (glm, gptoss) merged HTR into MBT; one candidate (qwen) separated them. Per rubric, same apparatus used for different behavioural domains = separate assays, so HTR is kept as its own entry.

All assays collapsed across timepoints (30 min, 6 h, 24 h) and Day 2 optogenetic reactivation per rubric ('Same test at different timepoints' = 1 assay; 'Same test under optogenetic manipulations' = 1 assay).
Did not score the in vivo two-photon calcium imaging, psychLight2 fiber photometry, scFLARE2 tagging, or snRNA-seq components — these are neural recording/molecular readouts, not behavioural assays.
B4 (ethological) for MBT scored Yes (digging/burying is natural ethological behaviour); for HTR scored No per rubric explicit guidance.

B1 for MBT scored 2 (2-3 measures: marbles buried, HTR count, locomotor velocity) — gptoss/glm reasoning. Note HTR is counted as a separate assay here, but locomotion is also reported in MBT analyses, so 2-3 measures applies.
Housing handling marked not_reported (low confidence) — the 1-week undisturbed period before testing does not constitute a deliberate handling/habituation protocol.
